authorial_core.source_request: 시각 의미 데이터와 후보 데이터에 반영해줘. 그 다음 스킬의 최신 버전을 사용하여 독립된 서브에이전트 3개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 이번에 반영한 주제가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 주제에 어울리는 랜덤한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.
authorial_core.interpreted_intent: Requester asks for an independently selected concept testing the mecha topic and using the portrait. Authorial concept: an inland-sea survey pilot pauses in an open giant walker's chest cockpit beside a stranded buoy; loss of the sea is conveyed by a high salt line and present dry ground. The viewer should feel intimate human presence within an oversized expedition machine. Compared a sealed night cockpit with a giant exterior silhouette: the open sunlit chest cockpit gives stronger simultaneous face, interior ownership and scale legibility. The pilot role, salt basin, map, suit and mood are optional authored staging, not requester requirements. The portrait supplies visible face and hair only, not identity, biography, personality or clothing.
authorial_core.subject: Human pilot seated inside a giant mechanical walker
authorial_core.setting: Dry inland sea bed beside a stranded buoy
authorial_core.event: Quiet expedition pause with an open chest cockpit
visual_priorities: A small seated pilot visibly belongs inside the broad machine torso
Recognizable portrait face and bob stay readable within the hatch
The stranded buoy and high salt line connect the machine to the dry former sea
authorial_core.baseline_prompt_en: A photograph of a mecha subject on the exposed bed of a vanished inland sea. As a mechanical structure, a giant mechanical walker stands beside a stranded survey buoy, the mechanical subject is visibly present as a coherent physical structure with a broad torso, articulated arms and heavy legs planted on cracked salt. Its chest hatch is open toward the camera, revealing a human pilot seated inside the torso. Use the supplied portrait as the pilot's facial and hair appearance reference. The pilot has a short dark brown bob, wispy separated bangs, brown eyes and softly rounded facial contours. Her face remains individually recognizable through the dusty cockpit opening. She wears a practical faded rust flight suit, its collar loosened at the throat, with a lap harness resting across her hips. Her left forearm rests on the open sill and her right hand holds a small paper route map against her thigh. Both knees remain inside the seat bay, her boots supported by its floor. She looks past the camera toward the buoy, lips slightly parted, catching her breath in the still heat. A white salt tideline high on the walker's shin and the buoy's flaking shell make the lost water level visible. The hatch rim, seated figure and broad machine shoulder form one connected silhouette. Photograph from a nearby maintenance platform level with the cockpit, a three-quarter exterior view wide enough to show the torso and a full near leg reaching the ground. Clear late-afternoon light warms her cheek and the worn steel while the far salt flats dissolve into pale haze; restrained analog color, tactile paint abrasion and quiet expeditionary intimacy.
